hello.speaker: uncle-bright
hello.text: Ah, {name}. Still looking for the young man's phone?

ask.speaker: player
ask.text: Things from room clearances come here, don't they? Lost property?

who.speaker: uncle-bright
who.text: They do. But lost property goes back to its owner. Who says that phone is for you?

choices.text: Kojo asked me to collect it for him.
It's mine. I lost it yesterday.
His charger was in my wardrobe — look, his name is on it.

truth.speaker: uncle-bright
truth.text: Kojo. Hmm. If he sent you, he trusts you. That is not nothing.

lie.speaker: uncle-bright
lie.text: Yesterday? That cabinet has not been opened since the rains. …I'm too old to argue with freshers.

charger.speaker: uncle-bright
charger.text: KOJO, all capitals. That's his hand — I've seen it in my book a hundred times.

open.speaker: uncle-bright
open.text: The cabinet is behind you. I've unlocked it. Take only what is his.
